action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX REQUIRED: The generate_simulation_data() function in /app/backend/server.py (lines 4639-4841) does not accept or use workspace_id parameter. When called from POST /api/simulation/generate endpoint (line 4855), it creates all simulation data WITHOUT workspace_id field. This breaks multi-tenant isolation - simulation data from different workspaces will mix together. FIX: (1) Add workspace_id parameter to generate_simulation_data(industry, workspace_id), (2) Add 'workspace_id': workspace_id to all generated records in the function (contacts, inbox_items, calendar_events, agents, activities arrays), (3) Update the endpoint call on line 4855 to pass workspace_id: result = await generate_simulation_data(industry, workspace_id). All other priorities are working correctly.
